current.text: Experts rate him as a late second round or early third round pick in 9-cat, around rank 18 to 24. Yahoo rank 18 is borderline but okay, pick 24 is strong, and ESPN rank 36 is very good value.
One expert thinks he is probably a top 20 player, above his ESPN rank of 36.
He is worth more in points leagues, where experts see him as a top 20 player, than in 9-cat.
He is the projected starting point guard in a lineup with Norman Powell, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson and Nick Claxton.
Coby White and Nikola Vucevic left Chicago. Norman Powell and rookie Caleb Wilson arrived.
Experts project about 33 to 34 minutes and about 23 usage.
His usage is expected to drop with a healthy roster. Norman Powell may lead the team in usage, and Matas Buzelis could be second, ahead of Giddey.
He should be the offensive hub and could reach about 10 assists per game without Coby White and Ayo Dosunmu. He still needs to score 15 to 16 points because the team lacks shooting.
His free throw percentage dropped last season and cost him value. Experts are not sure it bounces back.
He dealt with ankle injuries last season.
Chicago should play a fast, up-tempo transition style, which suits his rebounding and transition play.
Chicago has 10 games in our fantasy playoff weeks (3-3-4) and 15 back-to-backs. The overall schedule is average, with one of only three five-game weeks of the season.

durable.text: Assists are his best category and a league outlier. Rebounds are also very high for a guard.
He is a reliable source of points, rebounds and assists, with possible double digit assists.
He commits many turnovers, a league outlier in the TO category.
He is not a high usage player, so his week to week variance comes from his percentages and steals.
Experts disagree on his three-point shooting. One says it improved to about 37% on low volume, another says it still needs to recover.
Rebounding and transition play are lasting strengths.
Availability is a concern. He needs to play more than 60 to 65 games to return his value.

note: Experts put him around rank 18 to 24 in 9-cat, and his Yahoo price of about 35 to 37 USD fits that range. Our league paid 31 USD last season. Paying above the mid 30s means paying for a top 15 player. His elite assists and strong rebounds work best in a punt TO build, where his 3.6 turnovers hurt little. Early in the season, check his free throw percentage and how much usage Powell and Buzelis take from him.
